newsitem.title: JAPAN: Itochu, PPG joint venture to make glass in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Itochu, PPG joint venture to make glass in Japan.

text.p: PPG-CI Co Ltd, a joint venture between Itochu Corp and PPG Industries Inc of the United States, said on Friday that it will start producing double-layered glass in Japan from June 1997.
PPG-CI will invest around 200 to 250 million yen for the construction of production lines, a company spokesman said.
Initial production capacity will be about 130,000 square metres a year, the spokesman said.
Glass sheet will be imported from North America as well as China, the spokesman said.
The move is aimed at taking advantage of increasing domestic demand for the double-layered glass, the spokesman said.
The joint venture is 51 percent owned by PPG Industries, and the rest by Itochu.
